title: Semiotics
modules: Semiotic Elements And Classes Of Signs
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the image which aids the completion of meaning-making in a context of language expressions."
Reference is the image which aids the completion of meaning-making in a context of language expressions.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a branch of semiotics which deals with structural meaning."
Semantics is a branch of semiotics which deals with structural meaning.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with the relation between the sign system and sign-using agents or interpreters (i.e., the human or animal users)."
Pragmatics is concerned with the relation between the sign system and sign-using agents or interpreters (i.e., the human or animal users).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a sign which would lose the character which renders it a sign if there were no interpretants."
A symbol is a sign which would lose the character which renders it a sign if there were no interpretants.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the study model of meaning-making, applying methods and theories from semiotics, linguistics, psychology, cognitive science, computational modelling, anthropology, philosophy and other sciences."

Cognitive semiotics is the study model of meaning-making, applying methods and theories from semiotics, linguistics, psychology, cognitive science, computational modelling, anthropology, philosophy and other sciences.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the study of the social dimensions of meaning, and of the power of human processes of signification and interpretation (known as semiosis) in shaping individuals and societies."

Social semiotics Social semiotics is the study of the social dimensions of meaning, and of the power of human processes of signification and interpretation (known as semiosis) in shaping individuals and societies.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the study of structural signs."
Syntax is the study of structural signs.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the internal, mental representation that mediates between the object and its sign."
The interpretant is the internal, mental representation that mediates between the object and its sign.
